No. 2078/9 – MONDAY, JULY 02, 2018
EXTRAORDINARY
CORRIGENDA
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: MUL/LND/02/ACQ/42 Land Ministry’s Ref No.: 4 /3/15/2014/VE/48.

I hereby give notice under Sub-Section (1) of Section 7, of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act No. 28 0f 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/ servitude which is required for a public purpose: DESCRIPTION OF THE LAND OR SERVITUDE TO BE ACQUIRED: Under mentioned land shown in the Surveyor Generals plan of F.V.P. 165, supplement No. 27, sheet No.30 prepared by Surveyor General situated in the village of Dewalegama, Dewalegama West Grama Niladhari Division, Mulatiyana Divisional Secretarys Division in Matara District Sourthern Province.
Lot No. 521 Name of the land: Honpalaketiya Watta; Description: Garden, Five coconut trees (about 11—15 years of age)and a rain tree (about 18 years of age); Claimant:
Government; Original Claimant: Tharaka Wasalamudaliarachchi, Nishantha Witharana; Extent: About 0.0341 Hectare.

Lot No. 522 Name of the land: Honpalaketiya Watta; Description: Garden, Five coconut trees (about 11—17 years of age)and two Attoniya trees (about 3 years of age); Claimant : Government; Original Claimant: Tharaka Wasalamudaliarachchi, Nishantha Witharana; Extent: About 0.0410 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at Divisional Secretariat Mulatiyana on the 12th day of September 2018 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 10th day of September 2018 the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for computation for the of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. SUSANTHA ATHTHANAYAKA Divisional Secretary, Mulatiyana. Mulatiyana Divisional Secretariat, 18th June, 2018. 07-500

IN the Notice, under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act which was published in the Gazette Extraordinary of the Democratic Socialist Republic of the Sri Lanka No.1996/7 dated 05th December 2016, I hereby inform that the Compensations Inquiry date and time should be amendment as follows from 03.03.2017 at 10.00 a.m. to 19.09.2018 at 10.00 a.m. and land deeds and documents in support of claim produced date should be amendment from 20.02.2017 to 05.09.2018.
